leakage.removal_reason: Assigned post-creation (not available at triage time); corr=0.595 with log(resolution_hours), fills 6.9% on fast issues vs 93.1% on slow — pure leakage.

prior_metrics_invalidated.note: These metrics were computed on a broken closed_at temporal split where test issues were closed before some train issues were created. Retracted. See ADR-0009.

vscode.note: LightGBM underperforms naive on vscode because there is no creation-time signal that predicts resolution time for this repo. The system detects this at the repo level (bucket classifier accuracy −22.08pp vs naive, 95% CI [−25.81, −18.02] — ADR-0025; the −70.5% figure above is the separate POINT-regression MAE degradation, not the bucket model's) and surfaces a badge to the user rather than presenting a prediction that is worse than the baseline. See /eval for full methodology.

deployment.gap_disclosure: resolution_predictor_{slug}.pkl was retrained on the corrected created_at split and uploaded to GCS on 2026-06-19, but engineer_features() also reads data/processed/{slug}_temporal_train.parquet at inference time for historical-aggregate features, and that companion file was NOT re-uploaded — GCS retained the pre-ADR-0009 parquet (uploaded 2026-05-02). MANIFEST.sha256 only covered data/models/*, so nothing detected the mismatch. Cloud Run revisions triageiq-api-00045-kpk (2026-06-19 06:00 UTC) through triageiq-api-00049-m26 (2026-06-20 17:41 UTC) served the corrected model weights joined against pre-fix training data — an internally inconsistent hybrid, not simply the old leaky behavior. See ADR-0009 'Deployment Correction' for full detail including measured before/after values on live /triage.

calibration.method: temperature scaling (sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV not used — custom T_opt applied to raw logit scores)

deployment.gap_disclosure: The calibrated classifier pkl was fitted on 2026-05-19 but the GCS artifact was not updated at that time. Production served the UNCALIBRATED classifier from approximately 2026-05-02 to 2026-06-19. The ece_test values below (0.138/0.156) were accurate for the calibrated model but were NOT what production was serving during that period.

calibration.isotonic_note: Isotonic calibration tested (vscode test ECE 0.072, k8s 0.026) but not shipped — accuracy CIs overlapped zero and temperature scaling is simpler/more interpretable.

judge.cross_family_rationale: Not one model grading its own homework — Cohere Command A is a different model family from the Groq/Meta LLaMA triage model.
judge.baseline_history_note: Re-baselined 2026-07-07 on the clean, train-decontaminated n=65 gold set with a local judge (ADR-0018, ADR-0019) — two changes at once (contamination removed AND judge switched llama-3.3-70b-versatile/Groq -> qwen3:8b/Ollama), not decomposed. The w1_1/w1_2/production_llama_score/cross_family_validation entries below are historical W1-era snapshots computed on the old n=60 set with the old judge — kept for the record, not comparable to the current dimensions block.

cross_family_validation.decision: Llama-70b retained as default judge — gap is -3.6pp, below the 5pp escalation threshold. High ranking agreement (r=0.729) confirms cross-family result is not an outlier.

microsoft/vscode.note: Data-limited secondary (ADR-0017) — n=11 gives this repo's mean a wider quality-regression tolerance band (0.45 vs k8s's 0.22). See reports/eval_baseline.json.

reranker.phase1_verdict: Mixed — k8s gain, vscode regression. Proceeded to robustness test.
reranker.phase2_verdict: CI crosses zero — the Phase 1 +6pp k8s result was a false positive at n=100. Reranker rejected. BGE FAISS k=20 baseline shipped.
reranker.slates_note: 8 cross-encoder candidates across 2 slates (general-purpose + duplicate/STS models); all failed or showed mixed/negative results before bge-v2-m3 robustness test.

conformal.caveats: Marginal (not conditional) coverage; assumes exchangeability. vscode train(2015-16)/test(2026, 7-day window) violates this — report empirical coverage, not theoretical guarantee.

microsoft/vscode.calibration_split: 40/60 of test (246 cal / 370 true-test); 30/70 (68.3%) also computed — 5.8pp divergence reported in ADR-0010 as temporal non-stationarity finding
microsoft/vscode.exchangeability_note: train 2015-10-13..2016-04-05, test 2026-04-21..2026-04-27 (7-day window). Temporal regime gap violates exchangeability; 74.1% empirical coverage vs 80% target is the honest outcome.
